evidence_policy: Only supplied extraction and existing repository derivatives. No new papers, correspondence or clinical evidence.

auroc.se_rationale: Illustrative precise, intermediate and imprecise scenarios on AUROC scale; not calibrated to these studies and not recovered sampling errors.
auroc.genuine_ci_transform: existing endpoint-derived logit SE, construction method unverified
auroc.model_selection_rationale: Conventional Lu logistic-regression baseline replaces the wholly excluded named index; analyst-selected, not an original verified primary model. Bose held-out test, mutually exclusive Dallas reports, and separately chosen Kenet algorithms. All seven other retained Lu alternatives are crossed systematically.
auroc.source_group_independence: assumed across four conservative dependency groups, not independently established
auroc.individual_plot_interval: Reported genuine 95% CI when supplied; otherwise assumed normal-logit 95% interval
auroc.warning: EXPLORATORY — uncertainty assumptions supplied by analyst; not validated pooled clinical accuracy.
auroc.fallback_solver: scipy.optimize.brentq on the same Paule-Mandel equation after failed library residual check; no input changes
auroc.additional_lu_selection_rule: Every other eligible retained Lu numerical AUROC, in original source-record order; one Lu model per scenario. Full crossing with the same Dallas, Kenet and SE choices; no maximisation.

diagnostic.design_effect_rationale: Analyst-supplied variance multipliers, not measured ICCs or observed effective sample sizes; 1 is naive independence. Yu inflation probes unit uncertainty without resolving attribution/linkage.
diagnostic.source_level_independence: assumed conditional independence between the two source summaries
diagnostic.heterogeneity_rationale: T=0 common-logit constraint; SD 0.5 and 1.0 illustrate increasing logit heterogeneity; +/-0.5 probes correlation in sensitivity/FPR coordinates. No T parameter is estimated.
diagnostic.interval: normal marginal intervals using known-assumed GLS covariance; chi-square(2) joint logit confidence ellipse
diagnostic.boundary_cells: stop; do not add continuity correction or alter counts
diagnostic.warning: EXPLORATORY — clustered windows, unresolved analysis units and assumed statistical parameters.
